today_content.sher_roman:
Ibtida-e-ishq hai rotaa hai kya,
Aage aage dekhiye hota hai kya.
today_content.sher_urdu:
ابتداِ عشق ہے روتا ہے کیا
آگے آگے دیکھئے ہوتا ہے کیا
today_content.english_translation: This is just the beginning of love, why do you weep? Wait and see what's yet to unfold.
today_content.caption:
Kya ye ishq ki buniyaad nahi, ke dard se waaqif ho?
Mir Taqi Mir ki zindagi khud ishq aur ranj ka ek lamba safar thi. Kai ahbaab aur unke bacchon ki maut, muashi tangdasti, aur unki shairi mein jhalakti dil ki har aah, is sher ki gehraai ko aur badhati hai.

Is ghazal ke kuch aur ash'aar:
Qaid mein ab bhi hai wohi Mir,
Phir jo aage dekhiye hota hai kya.

Shab ko us ke dar pe jaa soye, Mir,
Ab wahi sarfaroshi hoti hai.
Aapki zindagi mein kab aaya tha aisa waqt?
